mapper.select: SELECT P.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", P.PROJECT_NAME AS "projectName", P.DESCRIPTION AS "description", P.SOURCE_DIR AS "sourceDir", P.SCM_TYPE AS "scmType", P.SCM_URL AS "scmUrl", P.USE_YN AS "useYn", P.UPDATED_AT AS "updatedAt", P.UPDATED_BY AS "updatedBy", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_management_project_db D WHERE D.PROJECT_ID = P.PROJECT_ID) AS "dbCount" FROM ai_management_project P ORDER BY P.PROJECT_ID

SELECT PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", PROJECT_NAME AS "projectName", DESCRIPTION AS "description", SOURCE_DIR AS "sourceDir", SCM_TYPE AS "scmType", SCM_URL AS "scmUrl", USE_YN AS "useYn" FROM ai_management_project WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT DB_SEQ AS "dbSeq", DB_NAME AS "dbName", JDBC_URL AS "jdbcUrl", USERNAME AS "username", SCHEMA_NAME AS "schemaName", DESCRIPTION AS "description", SORT_ORDER AS "sortOrder", CASE WHEN PASSWORD_ENC IS NULL OR PASSWORD_ENC = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS "hasPassword" FROM ai_management_project_db WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} ORDER BY SORT_ORDER, DB_SEQ

SELECT D.PROJECT_ID AS "projectId", P.PROJECT_NAME AS "projectName", D.DB_NAME AS "dbName", D.JDBC_URL AS "jdbcUrl", D.USERNAME AS "username", D.PASSWORD_ENC AS "passwordEnc", D.SCHEMA_NAME AS "schemaName", D.DESCRIPTION AS "description" FROM ai_management_project_db D JOIN ai_management_project P ON P.PROJECT_ID = D.PROJECT_ID WHERE P.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.PROJECT_ID, D.SORT_ORDER, D.DB_SEQ
SELECT PASSWORD_ENC FROM ai_management_project_db WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND DB_SEQ = #{dbSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_management_project (PROJECT_ID, PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SOURCE_DIR, SCM_TYPE, SCM_URL, USE_YN, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY, UPDATED_AT, UPDATED_BY) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{projectName}, #{description}, #{sourceDir}, #{scmType}, #{scmUrl}, #{useYn}, now(), #{by}, now(), #{by}) ON CONFLICT (PROJECT_ID) DO UPDATE SET PROJECT_NAME = EXCLUDED.PROJECT_NAME, DESCRIPTION = EXCLUDED.DESCRIPTION, SOURCE_DIR = EXCLUDED.SOURCE_DIR, SCM_TYPE = EXCLUDED.SCM_TYPE, SCM_URL = EXCLUDED.SCM_URL, USE_YN = EXCLUDED.USE_YN, UPDATED_AT = now(), UPDATED_BY = EXCLUDED.UPDATED_BY

INSERT INTO ai_management_project_db (PROJECT_ID, DB_SEQ, DB_NAME, JDBC_URL, USERNAME, PASSWORD_ENC, SCHEMA_NAME, DESCRIPTION, SORT_ORDER, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{dbSeq}, #{dbName}, #{jdbcUrl}, #{username}, #{passwordEnc}, #{schemaName}, #{description}, #{sortOrder}, now(), now())
